snippet.title: Bullet Heaven Meets RPG ! ⚔️🛡️ Slime Attack: Survivor | Out Now!
snippet.description:
It’s Slime Season! 🦠✨

Out now on Steam. 📅

The ultimate Action Bullet Heaven Meets RPG in the official trailer for Slime Attack: Survivor!

In this trailer, get a first look at the unique hero progression and the high-density combat that defines the experience. No two runs are identical—every choice you make with your gear and ability synergies alters how you engage the swarm. 🎒🔥

Core Gameplay Features:

⚔️ Loadout Galore: Experiment with a massive variety of weapons, gear, and active abilities to find the perfect setup for your playstyle.

🧬 Deep RPG Progression: Customize your hero with persistent stat upgrades and complex skill paths that allow for specialized, high-tier builds.

💥 The Synergy System: Discover powerful ability combinations that transform your basic attacks into screen-clearing effects.

🦠 The Infinite Swarm: Face massive, reactive slime hoards that test the limits of your build and your reflexes.

Are you ready for the Slime invasion? ⚔️🔥

📅 Release Date: March 9, 2026 

🔗 Stay Updated: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3428930/Slime_Attack_Survivor

🎵 Music Credits: Background music by FesliyanStudios: https://www.fesliyanstudios.com
